```{r}
#| label: fig-roc
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false
#| fig-cap: "Optimal cut-offs for bilirubin"
#| fig-subcap:
#|  - In-hospital death
#|  - All-cause death at 12 months
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| layout-nrow: 1

rocfunc <- function(outvar) {
  roc_obj <- roc(response = escdata %>% pull(!!sym(outvar)), predictor = escdata$Bili_mgdL, quiet = T)

  coords <- pROC::coords(roc_obj, "best", best.method = "youden")

  x <- 1 - coords$specificity
  y <- coords$sensitivity
  threshold <- fn(coords$threshold, 2)
  auc <- fn(auc(roc_obj)[1], 3)

  rocdata <- tibble(
    fpr = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
    tpr = roc_obj$sensitivities
  )

  p <- ggplot(rocdata, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr)) +
    # Draw the random guess reference line
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.75) +
    # Draw the ROC curve
    geom_path(colour = global_cols[1], linewidth = 2) +
    # Highlight the optimal cut-off point
    annotate("point", x = x, y = y, color = global_cols[2], size = 4) +
    annotate("text",
      x = x + 0.03, y = y + 0.06,
      label = paste0("Optimal Cut-off: ", threshold),
      hjust = 1, color = global_cols[2], fontface = "bold", size = 7
    ) +
    annotate("text",
      x = 0.6, y = 0.2,
      label = paste0("AUC = ", auc),
      size = 7, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "False Positive Rate (1 - Specificity)",
      y = "True Positive Rate (Sensitivity)"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_line(
        color = "lightgrey",
        linewidth = 0.5,
        linetype = 2
      ),
      text = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
    )

  if (output) {
    create_pptx(p)
  }
  p
}
rocfunc(outvar = "death_inhosp")
rocfunc(outvar = "death_fu")
```
